questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Matters
This tests your ability to build ephemeral environments for PR reviews - a key DevOps skill. You need to show you understand AKS namespaces, Helm deployments, secret management, and cost control through automated cleanup.

## Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Azure DevOps Pipeline                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. Trigger: PR created/updated                                 │
│  2. Create Namespace (pr-{PR_ID})                               │
│  3. Deploy Helm charts to namespace                             │
│  4. Inject Key Vault secrets                                    │
│  5. Run integration tests                                      │
│  6. Update PR with environment URL                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Complete Pipeline YAML

```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - '*'

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  helmVersion: '3.14.0'
  prNamespace: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-ephemeral-secrets'

stages:
  - stage: Setup
    displayName: 'Create PR Environment'
    jobs:
      - job: CreateNamespace
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Connect to AKS'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create PR Namespace with Quotas'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl create namespace $(prNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
                cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: ResourceQuota
                metadata:
                  name: pr-quota
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  hard:
                    requests.cpu: '4'
                    requests.memory: 8Gi
                    pods: '20'
                ---
                apiVersion: v1
                kind: LimitRange
                metadata:
                  name: pr-limits
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  limits:
                    - default:
                        cpu: '1'
                        memory: 2Gi
                      defaultRequest:
                        cpu: '100m'
                        memory: 256Mi
                      type: Container
                EOF

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch PR Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to PR Environment'
    dependsOn: Setup
    jobs:
      - job: HelmDeploy
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure kubectl'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup)

          - task: HelmInstaller@1
            displayName: 'Install Helm'
            inputs:
              helmVersionToInstall: $(helmVersion)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Helm Release'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                helm upgrade --install pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) ./charts/microservices 
                  --namespace $(prNamespace) --create-namespace 
                  --set image.tag=$(Build.BuildId) 
                  --set environment=pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) 
                  --wait --timeout 5m

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create CSI SecretProviderClass'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
                apiVersion: secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1
                kind: SecretProviderClass
                metadata:
                  name: pr-azure-kv-secret
                  namespace: $(prNamespace)
                spec:
                  provider: azure
                  parameters:
                    useVMManagedIdentity: "true"
                    vaultName: "$(keyVaultName)"
                    secrets: |
                      - secretName: db-connection-string
                        objectName: "pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)-db-connection"
                        objectType: secret
                EOF

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: IntegrationTests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Isolated Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                export DB_NAME="test_pr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)_orders"
                export TEST_USER_PREFIX="pr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)_test_"
                npm test -- --testPathPattern=integration

  - stage: Teardown
    displayName: 'Cleanup PR Environment'
    condition: eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')
    jobs:
      - job: CleanupResources
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Namespace & Helm Release'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing
                helm uninstall pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) -n $(prNamespace) || true
                kubectl delete namespace $(prNamespace) --wait=true --timeout=5m || true
```

## TTL Cleanup Pipeline (Scheduled)

```yaml
trigger: none
schedules:
  - cron: '0 0 * * *'
    branches:
      include:
        - main

variables:
  aksClusterName: 'ephemeral-aks-cluster'
  resourceGroup: 'rg-ephemeral-environments'
  ttlHours: 48

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    displayName: 'Delete Expired PR Namespaces'
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        az aks get-credentials --name $(aksClusterName) --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --overwrite-existing
        for NS in $(kubectl get ns -o jsonpath='{range .items[?(@.metadata.name=~"^pr-")]} {.metadata.name} {end}'); do
          AGE_HOURS=$(($(date +%s) - $(date -d $(kubectl get ns $NS -o jsonpath='{.metadata.creationTimestamp}') +%s)) / 3600)
          if [ $AGE_HOURS -gt $(ttlHours) ]; then
            helm uninstall -n $NS || true
            kubectl delete ns $NS --wait=true
          fi
        done
```

## Security Considerations

| Area | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Network Isolation | Azure Network Policy restricts pod-to-pod communication between PR namespaces |
| Secret Isolation | Per-PR Key Vault secrets with restricted access policies; use Managed Identity |
| RBAC | Cluster-level RoleBinding to limit PR deployment access |
| Registry | Private endpoints for container registry |

## Cost Optimization

1. **Shared Cluster**: Single AKS cluster amortizes control plane costs
2. **Auto-Scaling**: Enable cluster autoscaler and HPA
3. **TTL Cleanup**: 24-48 hour TTL prevents orphaned resources
4. **Spot Nodes**: Use spot/preemptible VMs (~60-80% savings)
5. **Resource Quotas**: Prevent PR monopolizing cluster resources

## Test Data Isolation

- Database naming: `orders_pr123`, `users_pr123`
- Test user prefixes: `pr123_test_user_001`
- Message queue topics: `pr123_orders`

## Telemetry Isolation

- Use custom dimension `pr_id` in Application Insights to filter PR-specific telemetry
- Tag all log queries with `environment=pr-{PR_ID}`

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical use of IaC validation, sandbox environments, and secret/configuration management within a real CI/CD workflow. Emphasizes the end-to-end lifecycle from pull request to production, with automated teardown and comprehensive observability.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML structure and pull request triggers
- Infrastructure as Code validation using Bicep and the Azure CLI
- Per-environment configuration via Azure App Configuration
- Secrets management via Azure Key Vault
- Container image build and deployment to isolated sandbox environments
- Production promotion with health checks
- Observability and logging with Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
# azure-pipelines.yml
trigger: none

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - name: resourceGroup
    value: 'pr-sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: aksClusterName
    value: 'pr-aks-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: acrName
    value: 'pracr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: imageName
    value: 'microservice:$(Build.BuildId)'
  - name: appConfigName
    value: 'appconfig-$(Environment)'
  - name: keyVaultName
    value: 'kv-$(Environment)'
  - name: sandboxTimeout
    value: 120  # minutes

stages:
  - stage: Validate_IaC
    displayName: 'Validate Infrastructure'
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_Sandbox
        displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Resources'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create -n $(resourceGroup) -l eastus
                az deployment group create \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file ./infra/main.bicep \
                  --parameters clusterName=$(aksClusterName) \
                             acrName=$(acrName)
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Set Sandbox Timeout'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Schedule sandbox deletion in 2 hours
                az monitor activity-log alert create \
                  -n sandbox-timeout-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) \
                  -g $(resourceGroup) \
                  --condition "category='Timer'" \
                  --action 'az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes'
                sleep $(sandboxTimeout)m || true
                az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait

  - stage: Build_and_Test
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    dependsOn: Validate_IaC
    jobs:
      - job: Build_Container
        displayName: 'Build Container Image'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Login to ACR'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az acr login -n $(acrName)
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: 'Build and Push Image'
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: $(acrName)
              repository: $(imageName)
              command: 'buildAndPush'
              Dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Fetch App Config and Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT]$(az appconfig show \
                  --name $(appConfigName) --query endpoint --output tsv)"
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Retrieve Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false
      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        displayName: 'Execute Unit Tests'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: 'Setup .NET'
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.x'
          - script: dotnet test --logger 'trx;LogFileName=results.trx'
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            displayName: 'Publish Test Results'
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
              testResultsFiles: '**/*.trx'

  - stage: Deploy_Sandbox
    displayName: 'Deploy to Sandbox'
    dependsOn: Build_and_Test
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_AKS
        displayName: 'Deploy Microservice to AKS'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        environment: 'sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: HelmInstaller@1
                  displayName: 'Install Helm'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Get AKS Credentials'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az aks get-credentials \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --name $(aksClusterName) \
                        --file $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: Bash@3
                  displayName: 'Deploy with Helm'
                  inputs:
                    targetType: 'inline'
                    command: |
                      helm upgrade --install microservice ./charts/microservice \
                        --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                        --set image.repository=$(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                        --set appConfig.endpoint=$(APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) \
                        --wait --timeout 5m

  - stage: Health_Check
    displayName: 'Verify Deployment'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Sandbox
    jobs:
      - job: Health_Check
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Wait for Pods Ready'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=microservice --timeout=120s
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Health Endpoint Check'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                POD_IP=$(kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  get pod -l app=microservice -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}')
                curl -f http://$POD_IP/health || exit 1

  - stage: Monitor_Logs
    displayName: 'Configure Azure Monitor'
    dependsOn: Health_Check
    jobs:
      - job: Setup_Monitoring
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Enable Container Insights'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks enable-addons \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --name $(aksClusterName) \
                  --addons monitoring
```

## Why This Is Asked
Ephemeral PR environments are a cornerstone of modern DevOps practices, enabling teams to validate changes in isolated environments without affecting production. This question assesses the candidate's understanding of Kubernetes lifecycle management, infrastructure-as-code practices, and observability in cloud-native deployments.

## Key Concepts
- PR-triggered ephemeral environments for isolated testing
- Kubernetes namespaces dynamically provisioned per PR
- Helm-based application deployments
- End-to-end smoke testing in isolated environments
- Automated teardown with policy safeguards and comprehensive logging

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
  paths:
    include:
    - src/**
    - charts/**
    - azure-pipelines.yml

variables:
  PR_NUMBER: $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber)
  NAMESPACE: 'pr-$(PR_NUMBER)'
  RETENTION_HOURS: 24
  AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION: 'Azure-Production'
  AKS_CLUSTER: 'aks-cluster-01'
  RESOURCE_GROUP: 'rg-aks-prod'

stages:
- stage: Provision
  displayName: 'Provision Ephemeral Environment'
  jobs:
  - job: CreateNamespace
    displayName: 'Create PR Namespace'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create AKS Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials \
            --resource-group $(RESOURCE_GROUP) \
            --name $(AKS_CLUSTER) \
            --overwrite-existing
          
          kubectl create namespace $(NAMESPACE) --dry-run=client -o yaml | \
            kubectl apply -f -
          
          kubectl label namespace $(NAMESPACE) \
            pr.number=$(PR_NUMBER) \
            pr.created=$(Build.BuildNumber) \
            environment=ephemeral --overwrite
          
          echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=NAMESPACE;isOutput=true]$(NAMESPACE)"
      name: namespaceInfo

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Log to Azure Monitor'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az monitor log-analytics query \
            --workspace $(LOG_WORKSPACE_ID) \
            --query "['EphemeralEnvironmentCreated']" \
            --analytics-duration 1 | tee /dev/stderr

- stage: Deploy
  displayName: 'Deploy Application'
  dependsOn: Provision
  jobs:
  - job: HelmDeploy
    displayName: 'Deploy with Helm'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: HelmInstaller@1
      displayName: 'Install Helm'
      inputs:
        helmVersionToInstall: 'latest'

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Configure AKS Credentials'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials \
            --resource-group $(RESOURCE_GROUP) \
            --name $(AKS_CLUSTER) \
            --overwrite-existing

    - task: HelmDeploy@0
      displayName: 'Deploy Helm Chart'
      inputs:
        connectionType: 'Azure Resource Manager'
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        azureResourceGroup: '$(RESOURCE_GROUP)'
        kubernetesCluster: '$(AKS_CLUSTER)'
        namespace: '$(NAMESPACE)'
        chartName: '$(CHART_REPO)/$(CHART_NAME)'
        chartVersion: '$(Build.BuildNumber)'
        releaseName: 'pr-app-$(PR_NUMBER)'
        overrideValues: |
          image.tag=$(Build.BuildNumber)
          ingress.hostname=$(NAMESPACE).$(DOMAIN)

- stage: Test
  displayName: 'Smoke Tests'
  dependsOn: Deploy
  jobs:
  - job: SmokeTests
    displayName: 'Run Smoke Tests'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Wait for Deployment'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          kubectl wait --for=condition=available \
            --timeout=300s \
            deployment/pr-app-$(PR_NUMBER) \
            -n $(NAMESPACE)

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Run Smoke Tests'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc -n $(NAMESPACE) \
            -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.loadBalancer.ingress[0].ip}')
          
          curl -f http://$SERVICE_IP/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://$SERVICE_IP/api/version || exit 1

- stage: Teardown
  displayName: 'Teardown Environment'
  condition: or(
    eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'),
    eq(dependencies.Provision.outputs['CreateNamespace.namespaceInfo.namespace'], '')
  )
  jobs:
  - job: DeleteNamespace
    displayName: 'Delete PR Namespace'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Policy Check Before Deletion'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          NAMESPACE=$(NAMESPACE)
          if [[ "$NAMESPACE" == pr-* ]]; then
            echo "Validating deletion policy for ephemeral namespace..."
            az policy assignment list \
              --scope /subscriptions/$(SUB_ID)/resourceGroups/$(RESOURCE_GROUP) \
              --query "[?displayName=='ProtectEphemeralNamespaces']" | tee /dev/stderr
          else
            echo "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]Non-PR namespace - skipping deletion"
            exit 1
          fi

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Delete Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          kubectl delete namespace $(NAMESPACE) --wait=true
          
          echo "Namespace $(NAMESPACE) deleted successfully"

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Log Deletion to Azure Monitor'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az monitor metrics alert create \
            --name "namespace-deleted-$(NAMESPACE)" \
            --resource-group $(RESOURCE_GROUP) \
            --description "Ephemeral namespace $(NAMESPACE) has been deleted"

resources:
  webhooks:
  - webhook: PRClosed
    connectionType: 'azureDevOps'
    project: '$(System.TeamProject)'
    pipeline: '$(Build.DefinitionName)'

schedules:
- cron: '0 0 * * *'
  displayName: 'Daily Cleanup'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
  always: true
```

## Key Implementation Details
1. **Namespace Creation**: Dynamically creates pr-${PR_NUMBER} namespace with metadata labels for tracking
2. **Helm Deployment**: Uses HelmDeploy@0 task with Azure Resource Manager connection for secure deployment
3. **Smoke Testing**: Validates application health and API endpoints post-deployment
4. **Policy Protection**: Validates namespace pattern before deletion to prevent accidental removal of non-prod environments
5. **Azure Monitor Logging**: All operations are logged for audit and troubleshooting
6. **Scheduled Cleanup**: Cron job ensures stale environments are removed after 24 hours
7. **Webhook Integration**: Triggers cleanup when PR is merged or closed

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  functionAppName: 'my-function-app'
  appConfigName: 'my-app-config'
  keyVaultName: 'my-key-vault'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run build
          - publish: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/dist
            artifact: drop

  - stage: Test_Audit
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Test_and_Lint
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run lint
          - script: npm test
      - job: Security_Audit
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm audit --audit-level=moderate

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Test_Audit
    variables:
      environment: 'staging'
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToStaging
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'
                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    labels: 'staging'
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'functionApp'
                    appName: $(functionAppName)
                    deploySlot: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    package: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/dist/*.zip'

  - stage: Load_Test
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_k6
        steps:
          - task: k6LoadTest@1
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/load-test.js'
             vus: '50'
              duration: '30s'
              threshold: 'p95=1200,error_rate=1'

  - stage: Promote_or_Rollback
    dependsOn: Load_Test
    jobs:
      - job: Check_conditions
        steps:
          - task: PowerShell@2
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                $metrics = @{
                  p95Latency = 1150
                  errorRate = 0.5
                }
                if ($metrics.p95Latency -lt 1200 -and $metrics.errorRate -lt 1) {
                  Write-Host "Promoting to production"
                } else {
                  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Promote conditions not met"
                  exit 1
                }
      - job: Promote_to_Production
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: succeeded()
        steps:
          - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'functionApp'
              appName: $(functionAppName)
              deploySlot: true
              slotName: 'staging'
              swapWithProduction: true
      - job: Rollback_on_Failure
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az functionApp deployment slot swap \
                  --resource-group my-rg \
                  --name $(functionAppName) \
                  --slot staging \
                  --target-slot production
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              alertsToSearch: 'all'
              insightsToSearch: 'all'
```
